name: Witness: A Bodyguard Romance
source:
After witnessing a mob murder, you're placed with a U.S. Marshal sworn to protect you from everything, even your own desires.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Witness:_A_Bodyguard_Romance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在目睹了一场暴民谋杀后，你被安置在一名美国元帅身边，他发誓会保护你免受一切伤害，甚至是你自己的欲望。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Witness:_A_Bodyguard_Romance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
